<documents>
<document id="savings-rate-change-2026">
Savingsˆrateˆchange,ˆJuneˆ2026ˆOnˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026,ˆweˆchangedˆtheˆratesˆonˆSavingsˆPockets.ˆHereˆareˆtheˆoldˆandˆnewˆrates.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆBeforeˆ|ˆFromˆtheˆchangeˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ0.75%ˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ2.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ4.10%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ##ˆWhyˆOurˆsavingsˆratesˆfollowˆwiderˆinterestˆrates,ˆwhichˆcameˆdownˆoverˆtheˆpastˆyear.ˆWeˆkeptˆtheˆgapˆbetweenˆplansˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆneedˆtoˆdoˆNothing.ˆYourˆpocketsˆstartedˆearningˆtheˆnewˆrateˆautomatically.ˆInterestˆearnedˆbeforeˆtheˆchangeˆwasˆcalculatedˆatˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆNoticeˆWeˆemailedˆeveryˆmemberˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆtheˆchange.ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆTheˆcapˆdidn'tˆchange.ˆPlanˆratesˆapplyˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆ##ˆThinkingˆaboutˆswitchingˆplans?ˆTheˆrateˆyouˆearnˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆUpgradingˆtakesˆeffectˆimmediately,ˆsoˆyourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆhigherˆrateˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆCompareˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆbeforeˆyouˆdecide.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-interest-calc">
HowˆsavingsˆinterestˆisˆcalculatedˆInterestˆonˆSavingsˆPocketsˆisˆcalculatedˆeveryˆdayˆandˆpaidˆonceˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆHowˆit'sˆcalculatedˆEachˆdayˆweˆworkˆoutˆinterestˆonˆtheˆbalanceˆinˆeachˆpocketˆatˆyourˆplan'sˆrate,ˆandˆitˆcompoundsˆdaily.ˆTheˆAPYˆalreadyˆincludesˆtheˆeffectˆofˆcompounding.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆpaidˆInterestˆforˆtheˆmonthˆisˆpaidˆintoˆeachˆpocketˆonˆtheˆfirstˆbusinessˆdayˆofˆtheˆnextˆmonth,ˆandˆshowsˆasˆ"Interest".ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆYourˆplan'sˆAPYˆappliesˆtoˆcombinedˆpocketˆbalancesˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆAnythingˆaboveˆthatˆearnsˆ0.10%ˆAPY.ˆ##ˆChangingˆplansˆIfˆyouˆchangeˆplans,ˆtheˆnewˆrateˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆdayˆtheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆInterestˆforˆearlierˆdaysˆinˆtheˆmonthˆusesˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆRateˆchangesˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆWeˆgiveˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆnoticeˆbyˆemailˆbeforeˆweˆlowerˆaˆrate.ˆYourˆmainˆbalanceˆdoesn'tˆearnˆinterest.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="support-no-advice">
FinancialˆadviceˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆexplainˆhowˆTallowbrookˆproductsˆwork,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆgiveˆfinancial,ˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadvice.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcan'tˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆWhetherˆtoˆinvest,ˆsaveˆorˆpayˆdownˆdebtˆ-ˆWhichˆstocks,ˆfundsˆorˆcryptocurrenciesˆtoˆbuyˆorˆsellˆ-ˆHowˆmuchˆofˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆkeepˆinˆsavingsˆ-ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆinterestˆorˆotherˆincomeˆonˆyourˆtaxesˆ-ˆLegalˆquestionsˆaboutˆwills,ˆdivorceˆorˆdisputesˆwithˆotherˆpeopleˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆ-ˆHowˆourˆsavingsˆratesˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆ-ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆonˆeachˆplan,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆdecideˆwhichˆsuitsˆyouˆ-ˆYourˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆgetˆadviceˆForˆadviceˆaboutˆyourˆsituation,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆqualifiedˆfinancialˆadviser,ˆtaxˆprofessionalˆorˆlawyer.ˆ##ˆInvestingˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆinvestmentˆorˆbrokerageˆaccounts.ˆSeeˆ"Investingˆandˆcryptocurrency".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
